theme: A vibrant and cartoonish fantasy town with colorful buildings and friendly NPCs.

zones.name: Welcome Square
zones.description: The central hub of the town, where players can interact with NPCs for upgrades and start their journey. Various shops and jobs are available here.

zones.name: NPC Shop District
zones.description: A district filled with colorful shops where players can purchase and sell items, as well as interact with NPCs to upgrade their character.

zones.name: Job Plaza
zones.description: A bustling area where players can take on various jobs and earn resources needed for upgrades.

zones.name: Character Upgrade Plaza
zones.description: A special area dedicated to character customization and upgrading, where players can interact with NPCs for unique upgrades.

sessionPacing.earlyGame: Players start in Welcome Square, interact with NPCs for initial tasks and upgrades. They then move to the Job Plaza to earn resources.
sessionPacing.midGame: Players continue upgrading their character while exploring more shops and taking on jobs. The Character Upgrade Plaza becomes a focal point as they progress.
sessionPacing.lateGame: As players near the end of the session, they focus on final upgrades in the Character Upgrade Plaza before potentially prestige.
